# Avoid misusing state update by copying the services state.

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Also found a potential bug in accumulation, where updates about `privilegedServices, authQueues and validatorData` where ignored.

- [x] Figure out the test failures

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- New Features
  - Added per-core authorization queue handling for more precise state updates.
  - Exposed additional accumulation data in updates (accumulation queue and recently accumulated).
- Bug Fixes
  - Improved gas accounting during on-transfer execution for more accurate reporting.
  - Ensured pending transfers and yielded roots are consistently applied in accumulation.
- Refactor
  - Streamlined state update construction with safer copying and validation.
  - Simplified deferred transfers flow to carry forward the latest state across iterations.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Refactors accumulation state handling by moving yieldedRoots into the AccumulationStateUpdate constructor, adding guarded copying, and making PartiallyUpdatedState hold a readonly stateUpdate. Updates accumulate logic to destructure state fields, compute per-core auth queues, and assert unknown fields. Refactors deferred transfers to iteratively update current state. Chain STF composes new fields.

## Changes
| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| **State update model refactor**<br>`packages/jam/jam-host-calls/externalities/state-update.ts` | Moves yieldedRoots to a constructor parameter property; updates constructor and copyFrom to pass a yieldedRoots map; conditionally copies validatorsData and privilegedServices; PartiallyUpdatedState now holds a readonly stateUpdate initialized via empty/copy. |
| **Accumulate transition adjustments**<br>`packages/jam/transition/accumulate/accumulate.ts` | Destructures stateUpdate (services, yieldedRoots, transfers, validatorsData, privilegedServices, authorizationQueues); computes root from yieldedRoots; builds per-core authQueues via tryAsPerCore; asserts no extra fields; shapes returned stateUpdate conditionally. |
| **Deferred transfers loop/state management**<br>`packages/jam/transition/accumulate/deferred-transfers.ts` | Introduces currentStateUpdate; constructs PartiallyUpdatedState inside loop; resolves service info from partial state; executes on-transfer and accumulates gas; updates currentStateUpdate from partial state; asserts no checkpoint; returns updated services. |
| **Chain STF composition updates**<br>`packages/jam/transition/chain-stf.ts` | Adds accumulationQueue and recentlyAccumulated to unpacking and final payload; excludes preimages from intermediate servicesUpdate; concatenates preimages with accumulatePreimages at return. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Caller
  participant Accumulate
  participant State as AccumulationStateUpdate
  participant Auth as tryAsPerCore

  Caller->>Accumulate: accumulate(state, stateUpdate)
  Accumulate->>State: Destructure {services, yieldedRoots, transfers, validatorsData, privilegedServices, authorizationQueues, ...rest}
  Accumulate->>Accumulate: assertEmpty(rest)
  Accumulate->>Accumulate: compute root from yieldedRoots
  Accumulate->>Accumulate: build authQueues (copy + apply updates)
  alt authorizationQueues not empty
    Accumulate->>Auth: tryAsPerCore(authQueues)
    Auth-->>Accumulate: per-core queues
  else
    Accumulate->>Accumulate: use {}
  end
  Accumulate-->>Caller: stateUpdate { services?, pendingTransfers, designatedValidatorData?, privilegedServices?, authQueues? }
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Caller
  participant Deferred as deferredTransfers
  participant PU as PartiallyUpdatedState
  participant Exec as OnTransferExecutor
  participant Check as check()

  Caller->>Deferred: run(inputServicesUpdate)
  Deferred->>Deferred: currentStateUpdate := inputServicesUpdate
  loop per service
    Deferred->>PU: construct with currentStateUpdate
    PU-->>Deferred: serviceInfo
    alt no code or no transfers
      Deferred->>Deferred: record zero/skip gas
    else on-transfer
      Deferred->>PU: update service balance
      Deferred->>Exec: create with partialState
      Exec-->>Deferred: consumedGas
      Deferred->>PU: get updated stateUpdate
      PU-->>Deferred: updatedState
      Deferred->>Deferred: currentStateUpdate := updatedState
      Deferred->>Check: assert no checkpoint
      Check-->>Deferred: ok
    end
  end
  Deferred-->>Caller: { servicesUpdate: currentStateUpdate.services, transferStatistics }
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant STF as ChainSTF
  participant Acc as accumulate
  participant Def as deferredTransfers

  STF->>Acc: run with previous state
  Acc-->>STF: { servicesUpdate, accumulationQueue, recentlyAccumulated, preimages: accumulatePreimages }
  STF->>Def: run with servicesUpdate (no preimages)
  Def-->>STF: { servicesUpdate: newServicesUpdate, transferStatistics }
  STF-->>STF: assemble final update { ...newServicesUpdate, accumulationQueue, recentlyAccumulated }
  STF-->>Caller: return with preimages.concat(accumulatePreimages)
```
